sourceRefs.locator: IV.22, MGH SS rer. Merov. 1.1, pp. 154–155. Chilperic uses royal treasure and enters Paris. His brothers dislodge him. The narrative pairs each of the four kings with a predecessor and a sedes.
Q41876 (Reims), P625, editorial neighbourhood around the rounded city reference, 4.03 E, 49.27 N.

processingNote.de: Die kleine Fläche hebt Reims als den von Gregor genannten Sitz hervor. Lage und Ausdehnung königlicher Gebäude bleiben offen.
processingNote.en: The small area highlights Reims as the seat named by Gregory. The location and extent of any royal buildings remain open.
